The usable area of a firecompartment is measured at floor level, between the rising partitions that enclose the room or group of rooms in question. The following are not taken into account when determining the GO: — the area of parts of floors above which the net height is less than 1.5 m, with the exception of floors under stairs, ramps, etc.; — a lift shaft; — a stairwell, ring hole or void, if its area is greater than or equal to 4 m2; — a free-standing building structure (other than a staircase) if its horizontal cross-section is greater than or equal to 0.5 m2; — a service shaft, if its horizontal cross section is greater than or equal to 0.5 m2; — a load-bearing internal wall.
